views.welcomeView.name: Audio Analyzer
viewsWelcome.contents:
Analyze audio files or folders.

[Select files / folder to analyze](command:audioWandasAnalyzer.analyzeFile)

You can also right-click an audio file or folder in the Explorer and choose "Analyze with Audio Analyzer".
configuration.title: Audio Wandas Analyzer
configuration.pythonCommand.description: Python environment folder used to launch the analysis backend. Existing Python executable values are still accepted. When unset, the Python extension's environment or VIRTUAL_ENV is used, else the first of py -3, python (Windows) or python3, python (elsewhere) that runs.
configuration.debugFilePath.description: Debug audio file or directory path used by the Analyze Debug Path command. Relative paths are resolved from the first workspace folder.
configuration.cacheMemoryMb.description: Upper limit, in MB, of the decoded audio the Python backend keeps in memory.
capabilities.untrustedWorkspaces.descrip: In Restricted Mode the Python environment and the debug path come from your user settings only; a workspace's own values for them are ignored.
